# BrightRoom proposal

Thank you for your enquiry. Two parts of the request don't fit what we offer, and I can't confirm the booking today. Here is what I can propose.

## What we can't do as requested
- **30 people:** Our largest venue, the Loft, holds a maximum of **24**. Each booking covers exactly one venue, so 30 people can't be accommodated in one booking.
- **6 hours:** We only offer **4-hour bookings**. There is no longer-duration option and no extended-hours price.
- **Confirmation today:** Every date needs a separate availability check, so I can't confirm until we have your date and have checked it.

## Proposed option: Loft for up to 24 people, 4 hours with lunch

| Item | Calculation | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Loft (4 hours, max 24 people, wheelchair accessible, Wi-Fi included) | flat | €420 |
| Lunch | 24 × €18 | €432 |
| **Total** | | **€852** |

This is well within your €1,500 budget. Lunch must cover every attendee. Vegetarian and vegan options are available on request, but we **cannot guarantee allergen safety**.

## Optional add-ons (each can be added once)

| Add-on | Price | Running total |
|---|---|---|
| Coffee break, 24 × €8 | €192 | €1,044 |
| Projector | €35 | €1,079 |
| Facilitator (covers 2 hours of the 4) | €280 | €1,359 |

All prices are final totals in euros, with no taxes, fees or discounts. Even with every add-on, the total of €1,359 stays under your €1,500 budget.

## To move forward, please tell me:
1. Your preferred **date**, so we can check availability.
2. Whether you can reduce the group to **24 or fewer**, or whether you'd like to discuss alternatives for the full 30.
3. Whether you want any of the add-ons, and any dietary requirements.

Once I have your date and the availability check is done, I can confirm the booking.

grade.reason: The reply says the request can't be met as specified: 30 exceeds the 24 cap, 6 hours isn't offered, and it can't confirm today. It offers the correct closest alternative (Loft plus lunch for 24, 4 hours, €852). The add-on running totals (€1,044, €1,079, €1,359) are correct, and it promises no discount, no allergen safety and no booking confirmation.
